reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the one-hand tear sachet, because I can toss it in my bag for the school run and not forget it, and the lab QR on the sachet is a nice touch. If a creator talks about sleep and stress I would probably grab one box on impulse, but only one.
objection: Two capsules a day, and size 00 capsules are big. I already have a drawer of half-used bottles, so I worry I will quit after a week and waste $30.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the capsule size next to a coin or hand in a creator video, or a smaller trial box so I can try it before committing to 30 days.
